name: add_private_quote_reference_storage
query: insert into storage.buckets (id, name, public) values ('quote-references', 'quote-references', false) on conflict (id) do nothing; do $$ begin if not exists (select 1 from pg_policies where schemaname = 'storage' and tablename = 'objects' and policyname = 'customers_upload_own_quote_references') then create policy customers_upload_own_quote_references on storage.objects for insert to authenticated with check (bucket_id = 'quote-references' and (storage.foldername(name))[1] = 'quote-references' and (storage.foldername(name))[2] = auth.uid()::text); end if; if not exists (select 1 from pg_policies where schemaname = 'storage' and tablename = 'objects' and policyname = 'customers_and_admins_read_quote_references') then create policy customers_and_admins_read_quote_references on storage.objects for select to authenticated using (bucket_id = 'quote-references' and ((storage.foldername(name))[2] = auth.uid()::text or exists (select 1 from public.profiles p where p.id = auth.uid() and p.role = 'admin'))); end if; end $$;
